quote: proposed in Kaplansky's 1956 talk at Shelter Island (published 1957)
note: The zero divisor and idempotent conjectures were formulated by Higman in his unpublished 1940 thesis, but the conjectures appeared in print in the report of Kaplansky's 1956 talk at Shelter Island, Rhode Island, which was published in 1957. This is the conventional attribution and publication date.
